scaleBeatText: With Haven grieving, Thornfield installs their own speaker at the table. Tribute rises to 7,500 kcal/week. Grief is leverage, and they know it. The link holds — it was never with one person.
With Haven grieving, Thornfield installs their own speaker at the table. Tribute rises to 11,250 kcal/week. Grief is leverage, and they know it. The link holds — it was never with one person.
🗣️ Angela to Milo, by the fire: "It waits. We wait. Somebody should check the snares — the table doesn't fill the pantry."
📺 CONTEST: The Long Odds. Dice against the house champion — a smug alien who has never lost on camera. The dice are fair. The stakes are the game. Raise, hold, or walk — but the table is unavoidable.

With Haven grieving again, Thornfield installs their own speaker at the table — and reaches for the grief card once more. The table has heard it before: the grief card is spent. Tribute stays at 11,250 kcal/week. The link holds — it was never with one person.

📺 The last roll. Everything staked is in the middle of the table, and the dice are in your hand.
